newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine winter wheat sowing moving ahead - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine winter wheat sowing moving ahead - ministry.

text.p: Ukraine's winter wheat sowing campaign is proceeding more quickly than last year, a senior Agriculture Ministry official said on Tuesday.
Ukraine has sown 3.482 million hectares with winter wheat, up from 2.895 million in 1995, Valentyn Tymoshenko told Reuters.
"This year winter wheat sowing is going well and the soil in most parts of our country has enough moisture for crops. That's going to mean a better harvest next year," he said.
He said the sowing campaign was better organised than in previous years. Recent rains throughout the country were creating good moist conditions, he added.
The government intends to increase winter wheat sowing areas this year to about 9.0 million hectares, up from last year's figure of 7.1 million hectares.
According to the Agriculture Ministry, Ukraine's winter wheat harvest was nearly over and stood at 13.14 million tonnes. The winter wheat crop was 16.4 million tonnes in 1995.

Last month Deputy Prime Minister Mykhailo Zubets predicted Ukraine's winter wheat harvest at 14 million tonnes this year. The government stands by its official forecast of 28 million tonnes for the total grain harvest, but some officials and analysts have said privately it could be as low as 26 million. --Yuri Kulikov, Kiev newsroom +380 44 229 2264
